about: Common furnishings for generation-2 houses (docs/design/TIER1_SWEEP.md section 14.5), read by house_sim/generator/furnishings.py. Each item is placed through the generator's Placer so it never cuts a walking route or anyone's access; an item that fits nowhere is skipped and reported (layout-audit note), never forced. The first type of 'types' that the registry knows is used; missing types are requested from their owner domain (owner) and reported.

items.source: sweep 14.5 (sofa cushions; type requested from textiles_laundry)
sweep 14.5 (throw pillows; textiles_laundry already puts two on the sofa, which count)

sweep 14.5 (ottoman 0.3; the core type is added by the main session at B6, conflict 37)
sweep 14.5 (coir doormat outside the front door; assumption: 85 % of homes have one)
sweep 14.5 (key bowl 0.4; it needs an entry surface)

crib.doc: every infant sleeps in a crib: the nursery's, else a new one in its own bedroom, else in its parents' room (AAP 2022 safe-sleep guidance: room-sharing without bed-sharing for the first 6 months), else any bedroom or the living room (a travel cot)

shared_bed.doc: a shared bedroom gets one twin bed per sleeper (the core furnisher's bedroom bed size)

high_chair.doc: sweep 14.5 (infants get a high chair, toddlers 0.6); one per household

chair_variants.doc: dining and kitchen-table chairs of one set share a material and colour (sweep 14.5: variants through props of existing types); assumption
